retained_limits: One CPU environment and one synthetic shape matrix; no learned activations or trained weights were used.
Non-dyadic native outputs differ by up to 1.1920928955078125e-7; general bit-exactness is not claimed.
The linked ordinary graph and ggml archive hashes are exact; source-to-archive provenance is an observed dirty workspace, not an attested clean build.
Any production gate still needs real shared-runtime controls and complete Moebius numerical replay with unchanged acceptance thresholds.
